Phylum Porifera

 Phylum Platyhelminthes

Phylum Nematoda

 Phylum Annelida

Phylum Mollusca

Phylum Arthropoda

 Phylum Chordata
• Characteristics of chordates

 Conclusion
• Recap of the major phyla of zoology and their characteristics
• Importance of studying biodiversity and the role of zoology in understanding it
• Future directions in zoological research and conservation efforts.
